name: Ferguson Enterprises
description: Ferguson distributes plumbing, HVAC, appliances, lighting, waterworks, fire protection and industrial pipe-valve-fitting products to contractors from about 1,750 branches and distribution centres in the US and Canada. It buys from about 37,000 suppliers (none over 5 percent of purchases) and earns the mark-up as a distributor, plus value-added services for complex projects. It calls itself the largest value-added distributor in a $340 billion North American water-and-air construction market, split roughly half residential, half non-residential, with repair and maintenance about two-thirds. The US segment (Ferguson brand) is 95 percent of sales and Canada (Wolseley) 5 percent. It moved its primary listing to the US and changed its fiscal year to December.

employees.note: About 35,000 associates (32,000 in the US, 3,000 in Canada), full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary.

businessLines.name: United States
businessLines.how: Resells products bought from about 37,000 suppliers to plumbing, HVAC, waterworks, fire, industrial and residential contractors from a common network of branches and distribution centres, earning a distributor mark-up; mostly repeat contractor orders tied to repair, maintenance and new construction.

businessLines.name: Canada
businessLines.how: Same distribution model under the Wolseley brand for plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, water and wastewater and industrial PVF customers.

brands.name: Ferguson
brands.note: US segment brand (95 percent of net sales)

brands.name: Wolseley
brands.note: Canada segment brand (5 percent of net sales)
